examples.question_text:
Write these numbers in words.
a. $286\,041\,753$
b. $64\,000\,219$
examples.solution_text:
a. Groups: $286\mid 041\mid 753$
Read $286$ million, $41$ thousand and $753$.
Two hundred and eighty-six million, forty-one thousand, seven hundred and fifty-three.
b. Groups: $64\mid 000\mid 219$
The thousands group is all zeros, so skip it when reading.
Sixty-four million, two hundred and nineteen.

examples.question_text:
Write each number as a numeral.
a. Three hundred and eight million, forty-six thousand, seventy-two.
b. A number with $57$ in the millions group, $9$ in the thousands group and $264$ in the ones group.
examples.solution_text:
a. The groups are $308$, $46$ and $72$.
Each group after the first needs three digits.
Groups: $308\mid 046\mid 072$
The numeral is $308\,046\,072$.
b. The groups are $57$, $9$ and $264$.
Write $9$ as $009$ to fill the thousands group.
Groups: $57\mid 009\mid 264$
The numeral is $57\,009\,264$.

examples.question_text:
In $358\,204\,716$:
a. Which digit is in the ten-millions place?
b. Which place does the digit $4$ occupy?
examples.solution_text:
Groups: $358\mid 204\mid 716$
a. In the millions group, $3$ is in hundred-millions, $5$ is in ten-millions and $8$ is in millions.
The ten-millions digit is $5$.
b. In the thousands group, $2$ is in hundred-thousands, $0$ is in ten-thousands and $4$ is in thousands.
The $4$ is in the thousands place.

examples.question_text: In $492\,063\,815$, name the places occupied by $9$ and $6$, and state their values.
examples.solution_text:
Groups: $492\mid 063\mid 815$
The $9$ is in the ten-millions place.
Its value is $9\times 10\,000\,000=90\,000\,000$.
The $6$ is in the ten-thousands place.
Its value is $6\times 10\,000=60\,000$.
